meta.source: Jobs and Skills Australia, Occupation profiles data (February 2026), ANZSCO basis
meta.earnings: ABS Survey of Employee Earnings and Hours, May 2025, customised report: median weekly and hourly pay for full-time non-managerial employees paid at the adult rate, before tax and salary sacrifice

occupations.name: Advertising, Public Relations and Sales Manager
occupations.description: Advertising, Public Relations and Sales Managers plan, organise, direct, control and coordinate advertising, public relations, sales and marketing activities within organisations.

occupations.name: Corporate Services Managers
occupations.description: Corporate Services Managers plan, organise, direct, control and coordinate the overall administration of organisations.

occupations.name: Finance Managers
occupations.description: Finance Managers plan, organise, direct, control and coordinate the financial and accounting activities within organisations.

occupations.name: Human Resource Managers
occupations.description: Human Resource Managers plan, organise, direct, control and coordinate the human resource and workplace relations activities within organisations.

occupations.name: Policy and Planning Managers
occupations.description: Policy and Planning Managers plan, organise, direct, control and coordinate policy advice and strategic planning within organisations.

occupations.name: Research and Development Managers
occupations.description: Research and Development Managers plan, organise, direct, control and coordinate research and development activities within organisations.

occupations.name: Construction Managers
occupations.description: Construction Managers plan, organise, direct, control and coordinate the construction of civil engineering projects, buildings and dwellings, and the physical and human resources involved in building and construction.

occupations.name: Engineering Managers
occupations.description: Engineering Managers plan, organise, direct, control and coordinate the engineering and technical operations of organisations.

occupations.name: Importers, Exporters and Wholesalers
occupations.description: Importers, Exporters and Wholesalers plan, organise, direct, control and coordinate the operations of importing, exporting and wholesaling establishments.

occupations.name: Production Managers
occupations.description: Production Managers plan, organise, direct, control and coordinate the production activities of forestry, manufacturing and mining organisations including physical and human resources.

occupations.name: Supply, Distribution and Procurement Managers
occupations.description: Supply, Distribution and Procurement Managers plan, organise, direct, control and coordinate the supply, storage and distribution of goods, products and services produced and used by organisations.

occupations.name: Child Care Centre Managers
occupations.description: Child Care Centre Managers plan, organise, direct, control and coordinate the activities of childcare centres and services including physical and human resources.

occupations.name: Health and Welfare Services Managers
occupations.description: Health and Welfare Services Managers plan, organise, direct, control and coordinate the professional and administrative aspects of health and welfare programs and services.
titles: Other Health and Welfare Services Managers

occupations.name: Other Education Managers
occupations.description: Other Education Managers plan, organise, direct, control and coordinate educational policy, and provide advice and educational and administrative support to staff and students in educational institutions.

occupations.name: ICT Managers
occupations.description: ICT Managers plan, organise, direct, control and coordinate the acquisition, development, maintenance and use of computer and telecommunication systems within organisations.

occupations.name: Commissioned Officers (Management)
occupations.description: Commissioned Officers (Management) provide high level management to support the running of organisational, geographical and operational units and sections within the defence forces and fire and police services.

occupations.name: Other Specialist Managers
occupations.description: Other Specialist Managers includes occupations such as Arts Administrators or Managers, Environmental Managers, Laboratory Managers, Quality Assurance Managers and Sports Administrators.

occupations.name: Cafe and Restaurant Managers
occupations.description: Cafe and Restaurant Managers organise and control the operations of cafes, restaurants and related establishments to provide dining and catering services.

occupations.name: Caravan Park and Camping Ground Managers
occupations.description: Caravan Park and Camping Ground Managers organise and control the operations of caravan parks and camping grounds to provide accommodation and leisure services.

occupations.name: Hotel and Motel Managers
occupations.description: Hotel and Motel Managers organise and control the operations of hotels and motels to provide guest accommodation, meals and other services.

occupations.name: Licensed Club Managers
occupations.description: Licensed Club Managers organise and control the operations of licensed clubs to provide food, beverages, gaming, entertainment, sporting and other amenities for members.

occupations.name: Other Accommodation and Hospitality Managers
occupations.description: Other Accommodation and Hospitality Managers includes occupations such as Bed and Breakfast Operators and Retirement Village Managers.
titles: Accommodation and Hospitality Managers (not covered elsewhere)

occupations.name: Retail Managers
occupations.description: Retail Managers organise and control the operations of establishments which provide retail services.

occupations.name: Amusement, Fitness and Sports Centre Managers
occupations.description: Amusement, Fitness and Sports Centre Managers organise, control and promote the activities, facilities and resources of amusement, fitness and sports centres.

occupations.name: Call, Contact Centre and Customer Service Managers
occupations.description: Call or Contact Centre and Customer Service Managers organise and control the operations of call or contact centres, review customer services, and maintain sound customer relations.
titles: Call Centre or Contact Centre Managers

occupations.name: Conference and Event Organisers
occupations.description: Conference and Event Organisers organise and coordinate services for conferences, events, functions, banquets and seminars.

occupations.name: Transport Services Managers
occupations.description: Transport Services Managers organise and control the buying and selling of vehicles for rental agencies and coordinate the leasing of vehicles, the operations of railway stations, and the operations of enterprises that operate fleets of vehicles to transport goods and passengers.

occupations.name: Other Hospitality, Retail and Service Managers
occupations.description: Other Hospitality, Retail and Service Managers includes occupations such as Boarding Kennel or Cattery Operators, Cinema or Theatre Managers, Facilities Managers, Financial Institution Branch Managers and Equipment Hire Managers.
titles: Hospitality, Retail and Service Managers (not covered elsewhere)

occupations.name: Actors, Dancers and Other Entertainers
occupations.description: Actors, Dancers and Other Entertainers entertain by portraying roles in productions, performing and composing dances, and performing a variety of other acts.

occupations.name: Music Professionals
occupations.description: Music Professionals write, arrange, orchestrate, conduct and perform musical compositions.

occupations.name: Photographers
occupations.description: Photographers operate still cameras to take photographs.

occupations.name: Visual Arts and Crafts Professionals
occupations.description: Visual Arts and Crafts Professionals create visual two- and three-dimensional concepts and forms through painting, drawing, carving, sculpting, modelling, printmaking, video, multimedia, found objects, ephemera, soundscapes and other media to communicate concepts and ideas.
titles: Other Visual Arts or Crafts Professionals

occupations.name: Artistic Directors, Media Producers and Presenters
occupations.description: Artistic Directors, and Media Producers and Presenters plan, administer and review activities concerned with producing artistic media, determine artistic policies for performing arts organisations, prepare and present news, sports and other information, and conduct interviews and introduce music, performances and special events on radio and television.

occupations.name: Film, Television, Radio and Stage Directors
occupations.description: Film, Television, Radio and Stage Directors direct the artistic and production aspects of film, television, radio and stage productions.
titles: Other Film, Television, Radio and Stage Directors

occupations.name: Journalists and Other Writers
occupations.description: Journalists and Other Writers research and compile news stories, write and edit news reports, commentaries and feature stories for presentation in print and electronic media, and compose written material to advertise goods and services.
titles: Bloggers, Critics, Sports and Other Writers (not covered elsewhere)

occupations.name: Accountants
occupations.description: Accountants provide services relating to financial reporting, taxation, auditing, insolvency, accounting information systems, budgeting, cost management, planning and decision-making by organisations and individuals; and provide advice on associated compliance and performance requirements to ensure statutory and strategic governance.

occupations.name: Auditors, Company Secretaries and Corporate Treasurers
occupations.description: Auditors, Company Secretaries and Corporate Treasurers conduct audits of accounting systems, procedures and financial statements, manage corporate funding and financial risk, and administer and review corporate compliance activities.

occupations.name: Financial Brokers
occupations.description: Financial Brokers operate as independent agents to facilitate the trading of commodities and arrange insurance and loans of money on behalf of clients.

occupations.name: Financial Dealers
occupations.description: Financial Dealers conduct financial market transactions on behalf of clients.

occupations.name: Financial Investment Advisers and Managers
occupations.description: Financial Investment Advisers and Managers develop financial plans for individuals and organisations, and invest and manage funds on their behalf.

occupations.name: Human Resource Professionals
occupations.description: Human Resource Professionals plan, develop, implement and evaluate staff recruitment, assist in resolving disputes by advising on workplace matters, and represent industrial, commercial, union, employer and other parties in negotiations on issues such as enterprise bargaining, rates of pay and conditions of employment.

occupations.name: Training and Development Professionals
occupations.description: Training and Development Professionals plan, develop, implement and evaluate training and development programs to ensure management and staff acquire the skills and develop the competencies required by organisations to meet organisational objectives.

occupations.name: Actuaries, Mathematicians and Statisticians
occupations.description: Actuaries, Mathematicians and Statisticians develop and apply actuarial, mathematical, statistical and quantitative principles and techniques to solve problems in a range of fields such as business and finance, scientific and social research, and engineering.

occupations.name: Archivists, Curators and Records Managers
occupations.description: Archivists, Curators and Records Managers develop, maintain, implement and deliver systems for keeping, updating, accessing and preserving records, files, information, historical documents and artefacts.

occupations.name: Economists
occupations.description: Economists perform economic research and analysis, develop and apply theories about production and distribution of goods and services and people's spending and financial behaviour, and provide advice to governments and organisations on economic policy issues.

occupations.name: Intelligence and Policy Analysts
occupations.description: Intelligence and Policy Analysts collect and analyse information and data to produce intelligence and to develop and analyse policies guiding the design, implementation and modification of government and commercial operations and programs.

occupations.name: Land Economists and Valuers
occupations.description: Land Economists and Valuers provide advice on the administration and use of land and property, and assess the value of land, property and other items such as commercial equipment and objects of art.

occupations.name: Librarians
occupations.description: Librarians develop, organise and manage library services such as collections of information, recreational resources and reader information services.

occupations.name: Management and Organisation Analysts
occupations.description: Management and Organisation Analysts assist organisations to achieve greater efficiency and solve organisational problems, and study organisational structures, methods, systems and procedures.

occupations.name: Other Information and Organisation Professionals
occupations.description: Other Information and Organisation Professionals includes occupations such as Electorate Officers, Liaison Officers, Migration Agents and Patents Examiners.
titles: Information and Organisation Professionals (not covered elsewhere)

occupations.name: Advertising and Marketing Professionals
occupations.description: Advertising and Marketing Professionals develop and coordinate advertising strategies and campaigns, determine the market for new goods and services, and identify and develop market opportunities for new and existing goods and services.

occupations.name: ICT Sales Professionals
occupations.description: ICT Sales Professionals manage client accounts and represent companies in selling a range of computer hardware, software and other ICT goods and services to industrial, business, professional and other organisations.

occupations.name: Public Relations Professionals
occupations.description: Public Relations Professionals plan, develop, implement and evaluate information and communication strategies that create an understanding and a favourable view of organisations, their goods and services, and their role in the community.

occupations.name: Technical Sales Representatives
occupations.description: Technical Sales Representatives represent companies in selling a range of industrial, medical and pharmaceutical goods and services to industrial, business, professional and other establishments.

occupations.name: Air Transport Professionals
occupations.description: Air Transport Professionals fly and navigate aircraft, control and direct air traffic to ensure the safe and efficient operation of aircraft in flight and on the ground, and instruct students in flying aircraft.

occupations.name: Marine Transport Professionals
occupations.description: Marine Transport Professionals control and manage the operations of ships, boats and marine equipment.

occupations.name: Architects and Landscape Architects
occupations.description: Architects and Landscape Architects design commercial, industrial, institutional, residential and recreational buildings and landscapes.

occupations.name: Surveyors and Spatial Scientists
occupations.description: Surveyors and Spatial Scientists plan, direct and conduct survey work to determine and delineate boundaries and features of tracts of land, marine floors and underground works, prepare and revise maps, charts and other geographic products, and analyse, present and maintain geographical information about locations in space and time.

occupations.name: Graphic and Web Designers, and Illustrators
occupations.description: Graphic and Web Designers, and Illustrators design information for visual and audio communication, publication and display using print, film, electronic, digital and other forms of visual and audio media.

occupations.name: Interior Designers
occupations.description: Interior Designers plan, design, detail and supervise the construction of commercial, industrial, retail and residential building interiors to produce an environment tailored to a purpose, with particular emphasis on space creation, space planning, and factors that enhance living and working environments.

occupations.name: Urban and Regional Planners
occupations.description: Urban and Regional Planners develop and implement plans and policies for the controlled use of urban and rural land, and advise on economic, environmental and social factors affecting land use.

occupations.name: Chemical and Materials Engineers
occupations.description: Chemical and Materials Engineers design and prepare specifications for chemical process systems and the construction and operation of commercial-scale chemical plants, supervise industrial processing and fabrication of products undergoing physical and chemical change, and investigate the properties of metals, ceramics, polymers and other materials and assess and develop their engineering and commercial applications.

occupations.name: Civil Engineering Professionals
occupations.description: Civil Engineering Professionals design, plan, organise and oversee the construction of civil engineering projects such as dams, bridges, pipelines, gas and water supply schemes, sewerage systems, roads, airports and other structures; analyse the likely behaviour of soil and rock when placed under pressure by proposed structures and design structural foundations; analyse the statical properties of all types of structures and test the behaviour and durability of materials used in their construction; plan and develop transportation systems; and estimate and monitor the construction costs of projects.

occupations.name: Electrical Engineers
occupations.description: Electrical Engineers design, develop and supervise the manufacture, installation, operation and maintenance of equipment, machines and systems for the generation, distribution, utilisation and control of electric power.

occupations.name: Electronics Engineers
occupations.description: Electronics Engineers design, develop, adapt, install, test and maintain electronic components, circuits and systems used for computer systems, communication systems, entertainment, transport and other industrial applications.

occupations.name: Industrial, Mechanical and Production Engineers
occupations.description: Industrial, Mechanical and Production Engineers design, organise and oversee the construction, operation and maintenance of mechanical and process plant and installations, establish programs for the coordination of manufacturing activities, and ensure usage of resources is cost effective.

occupations.name: Mining Engineers
occupations.description: Mining Engineers plan and direct the engineering aspects of locating and extracting minerals, petroleum and natural gas from the earth.

occupations.name: Other Engineering Professionals
occupations.description: Other Engineering Professionals includes occupations such as Aeronautical Engineers, Agricultural Engineers, Biomedical Engineers, Engineering Technologists, Environmental Engineers and Naval Architects.

occupations.name: Agricultural and Forestry Scientists
occupations.description: Agricultural and Forestry Scientists advise farmers, rural industries and government on aspects of farming, develop techniques for increasing productivity, and study and develop plans and policies for the management of forest areas.

occupations.name: Chemists, and Food and Wine Scientists
occupations.description: Chemists, and Food and Wine Scientists study the chemical and physical properties of substances, develop and monitor chemical processes and production, develop new and improve existing food products, and plan and coordinate the production of wine and spirits.

occupations.name: Environmental Scientists
occupations.description: Environmental Scientists study, develop, implement and advise on policies and plans for managing and protecting the environment, flora, fauna and other natural resources.

occupations.name: Geologists, Geophysicists and Hydrogeologists
occupations.description: Geologists, Geophysicists and Hydrogeologists study the composition, structure and other physical attributes of the earth, locate and advise on the extraction of minerals, petroleum and ground water, and detect, monitor and forecast seismic, magnetic, electrical, thermal and oceanographic activity. Geographers are not included here, they are included in Social Professionals.

occupations.name: Life Scientists
occupations.description: Life Scientists examine the anatomy, physiology and biochemistry of humans, animals, plants and other living organisms to better understand how living organisms function and interact with each other and the environment in which they live.

occupations.name: Medical Laboratory Scientists
occupations.description: Medical Laboratory Scientists conduct medical laboratory tests to assist in the diagnosis, treatment and prevention of disease.

occupations.name: Veterinarians
occupations.description: Veterinarians diagnose, treat and prevent animal diseases, ailments and injuries.

occupations.name: Other Natural and Physical Science Professionals
occupations.description: Other Natural and Physical Science Professionals includes occupations such as Conservators, Metallurgists, Meteorologists and Physicists.
titles: Natural and Physical Science Professionals (not covered elsewhere)

occupations.name: Early Childhood (Pre-primary School) Teachers
occupations.description: Early Childhood (Pre-Primary School) Teachers teach the basics of numeracy, literacy, music, art and literature to early childhood (pre-primary) students and promote students' social, emotional, intellectual and physical development.

occupations.name: Primary School Teachers
occupations.description: Primary School Teachers teach a range of subjects within a prescribed curriculum to primary school students and promote students' social, emotional, intellectual and physical development.

occupations.name: Middle School Teachers
occupations.description: Middle School Teachers teach one or more subjects within a prescribed curriculum to middle school or intermediate school students and promote students' social, emotional, intellectual and physical development.

occupations.name: Secondary School Teachers
occupations.description: Secondary School Teachers teach one or more subjects within a prescribed curriculum to secondary school students and promote students' social, emotional, intellectual and physical development.

occupations.name: Special Education Teachers
occupations.description: Special Education Teachers teach primary, middle or intermediate, and secondary school students with learning difficulties, hearing impairment and sight impairment, and promote students' social, emotional, intellectual and physical development.

occupations.name: University Lecturers and Tutors
occupations.description: University Lecturers and Tutors prepare and deliver lectures and conduct tutorials in one or more subjects within a prescribed course of study at a university and conduct research in a particular field of knowledge.

occupations.name: Vocational Education Teachers
occupations.description: Vocational Education Teachers teach one or more subjects within a prescribed course of study at technical and further education (TAFE) institutes, polytechnics and other training institutes to tertiary students for vocational education and training purposes.

occupations.name: Education Advisers and Reviewers
occupations.description: Education Advisers and Reviewers conduct educational research, develop course curricula and associated teaching materials for use by educational institutions, and review and examine the work of teachers and the results from curriculum programs in school settings.

occupations.name: Private Tutors and Teachers
occupations.description: Private Tutors and Teachers teach students in the practice, theory and performance of subjects, such as art, dance, drama and music, in private training establishments.

occupations.name: Teachers of English to Speakers of Other Languages
occupations.description: Teachers of English to Speakers of other Languages teach classes in English to students whose first language is a language other than English.

occupations.name: Nutrition Professionals
occupations.description: Nutrition Professionals apply the science of human nutrition to assist people to attain better health and to help prevent and treat various illnesses and diseases.

occupations.name: Medical Imaging Professionals
occupations.description: Medical Imaging Professionals operate X-ray and other radiation producing and imaging equipment for diagnostic, monitoring and treatment purposes under the direction of Radiologists and other Medical Practitioners.

occupations.name: Occupational and Environmental Health Professionals
occupations.description: Occupational and Environmental Health Professionals develop, implement and evaluate policies and programs to monitor environmental health and occupational health and safety and related legislation to ensure safe and healthy working conditions, and assist injured staff through the workers' compensation and rehabilitation process.

occupations.name: Pharmacists
occupations.description: Pharmacists ensure safe and quality use of medicines, and optimise health outcomes by contributing to selecting, prescribing, monitoring and evaluating medicine therapy, and researching, testing and developing pharmaceuticals and medical products.

occupations.name: Other Health Diagnostic and Promotion Professionals
occupations.description: Other Health Diagnostic and Promotion Professionals includes occupations such as Health Promotion Officers and Orthotists or Prosthetists.
titles: Genetic Counsellors (and Other Health Professionals not covered elsewhere)

occupations.name: Dental Practitioners
occupations.description: Dental Practitioners diagnose and treat dental disease, restore normal oral function using a broad range of treatments, such as surgery and other specialist techniques, and advise on oral health.

occupations.name: Occupational Therapists
occupations.description: Occupational Therapists assess functional limitations of people resulting from illnesses and disabilities, and provide therapy to enable people to perform their daily activities and occupations.

occupations.name: Physiotherapists
occupations.description: Physiotherapists assess, treat and prevent disorders in human movement caused by injury or disease.

occupations.name: Audiologists and Speech Pathologists \ Therapists
occupations.description: Audiologists and Speech Pathologists provide diagnostic assessment, treatment, rehabilitative services and management of human hearing defects, and communication and swallowing impairments.

occupations.name: General Practitioners and Resident Medical Officers
occupations.description: General Practitioners and Resident Medical Officers diagnose and treat physical and mental illnesses, disorders and injuries, recommend preventative action and refer patients to specialist Medical Practitioners, other health care workers, and social, welfare and support workers.

occupations.name: Anaesthetists
occupations.description: Anaesthetists provide direct medical care to patients requiring general or local anaesthesia for surgical, diagnostic and other procedures such as prevention of pain and maintenance of body function. Anaesthetic Registrars training as Anaesthetists are included here.

occupations.name: Specialist Physicians
occupations.description: Specialist Physicians diagnose and treat internal human disorders and diseases using specialist testing, diagnostic and medical techniques. Medical Registrars training as Specialist Physicians are included here.

occupations.name: Surgeons
occupations.description: Surgeons perform surgery to correct deformities, repair injuries, prevent and treat diseases, and improve human functioning and appearance. Medical Registrars training as Surgeons are included here.

occupations.name: Other Medical Practitioners
occupations.description: Other Medical Practitioners includes occupations such as Dermatologists, Emergency Medicine Specialists, Obstetricians and Gynaecologists, Ophthalmologists, Pathologists, Diagnostic and Interventional Radiologists, and Radiation Oncologists. Medical Registrars training in these specialties are included here.

occupations.name: Midwives
occupations.description: Midwives provide care and advice to women during pregnancy, labour and childbirth, and postnatal care for women and babies in a range of settings such as the home, community, hospitals, clinics and health units.

occupations.name: Nurse Educators and Researchers
occupations.description: Nurse Educators and Researchers provide clinical and theoretical education to and promote professional development of nurses and midwives, and conduct research into nursing practice.

occupations.name: Nurse Managers
occupations.description: Nurse Managers manage health service units and sub-units of hospitals, aged care and community health care facilities, supervise nursing staff and financial resources to enable the provision of safe, cost effective nursing care within specified fields or for particular units, and monitor quality, clinical standards and professional development of nurses.

occupations.name: Registered Nurses
occupations.description: Registered Nurses provide nursing care to patients in hospitals, aged care and other health care facilities, and in the community.

occupations.name: ICT Business and Systems Analysts
occupations.description: ICT Business and Systems Analysts work with users to formulate system requirements, develop system plans and documentation, review and evaluate existing systems, and design and modify systems to meet users' business needs.

occupations.name: Multimedia Specialists and Web Developers
occupations.description: Multimedia Specialists and Web Developers create computer animation, audio, video and graphic image files for multimedia presentations, games, motion pictures, CD-ROMs, information kiosks and the web, and plan, produce and maintain websites and web applications using web programming, scripting, authoring, content management and file transfer software.

occupations.name: Software and Applications Programmers
occupations.description: Software and Applications Programmers design, develop, test, maintain and document program code in accordance with user requirements, and system and technical specifications.

occupations.name: Database and Systems Administrators, and ICT Security Specialists
occupations.description: Database and Systems Administrators, and ICT Security Specialists plan, develop, maintain, manage and administer organisations' database management systems, operating systems and security policies and procedures to ensure optimal database and system integrity, security, backup, reliability and performance.

occupations.name: Computer Network Professionals
occupations.description: Computer Network Professionals research, analyse and recommend strategies for network architecture and development, implement, manage, maintain and configure network hardware and software, and monitor and optimise performance, and troubleshoot and provide user support.

occupations.name: ICT Support and Test Engineers
occupations.description: ICT Support and Test Engineers develop procedures and strategies to support, create, maintain and manage technical quality assurance processes and guidelines and systems infrastructure, investigate, analyse and resolve system problems and performance issues, and test the behaviour, functionality and integrity of systems.
titles: Other ICT Support and Test Engineers

occupations.name: Telecommunications Engineering Professionals
occupations.description: Telecommunications Engineering Professionals design, construct, install, service and support telecommunications equipment, systems and facilities.

occupations.name: Barristers
occupations.description: Barristers plead cases before civil, criminal and industrial courts and other tribunals.

occupations.name: Judicial and Other Legal Professionals
occupations.description: Judicial and Other Legal Professionals hear legal and other matters in courts and tribunals; interpret, analyse, administer and provide advice on the law; and draft legislation.
titles: Judicial and Other Legal Professionals (not covered elsewhere)

occupations.name: Solicitors
occupations.description: Solicitors provide legal advice, prepare and draft legal documents, and conduct negotiations on behalf of clients on matters associated with the law.

occupations.name: Counsellors
occupations.description: Counsellors provide information on vocational, relationship, social and educational difficulties and issues, and work with people to help them to identify and define their emotional issues through therapies such as cognitive behaviour therapy, interpersonal therapy and other talking therapies.

occupations.name: Ministers of Religion
occupations.description: Ministers of Religion perform spiritual functions associated with beliefs and practices of religious faiths, and provide motivation, guidance and training in religious life for the people of congregations and parishes, and the wider community.

occupations.name: Psychologists and Psychotherapists
occupations.description: Psychologists and Psychotherapists investigate, assess and provide treatment and counselling to foster optimal personal, social, educational and occupational adjustment and development.

occupations.name: Social Professionals
occupations.description: Social Professionals research and study human behaviour, society and institutions from current and historical perspectives, and verbally render spoken statements, and transcribe text and recorded spoken material from one language into another.

occupations.name: Social Workers
occupations.description: Social Workers assess the social needs of individuals, families and groups, assist and empower people to develop and use the skills and resources needed to resolve social and other problems, and further human wellbeing and human rights, social justice and social development.

occupations.name: Welfare, Recreation and Community Arts Workers
occupations.description: Welfare, Recreation and Community Arts Workers design and implement strategies and programs to meet community and individual needs and assist individuals, families and groups with social, emotional and financial difficulties to improve quality of life by educating and supporting them and working towards change in their social environment.

occupations.name: Agricultural Technicians
occupations.description: Agricultural Technicians perform tests and experiments, and provide technical support to assist Agricultural Scientists in areas such as research, production, servicing and marketing.

occupations.name: Medical Technicians
occupations.description: Medical Technicians operate anaesthetic, cardiac, operating theatre and medical testing equipment, perform and assist with laboratory tests, and fill prescriptions in support of Health Professionals.

occupations.name: Primary Products Inspectors
occupations.description: Primary Products Inspectors inspect animals, plants and agricultural produce and facilities to ensure compliance with government and industry standards with respect to quality, health and licensing.

occupations.name: Science Technicians
occupations.description: Science Technicians perform tests and experiments, and provide technical support functions to assist with research, design, production and teaching in chemistry, earth sciences, life sciences, and physical sciences.

occupations.name: Architectural, Building and Surveying Technicians
occupations.description: Architectural, Building and Surveying Technicians perform technical functions to assist Construction Managers, Architects and Surveyors by supervising and inspecting construction sites, estimating time, costs and resources, inspecting plumbing work, and collecting and evaluating survey data and preparing maps and plans.
titles: Other Architectural, Building and Surveying Technicians

occupations.name: Civil Engineering Draftspersons and Technicians
occupations.description: Civil Engineering Draftspersons and Technicians assist in civil engineering research, design, construction, operations and maintenance.

occupations.name: Electrical Engineering Draftspersons, Technicians
occupations.description: Electrical Engineering Draftspersons and Technicians assist in electrical engineering research, design, manufacture, assembly, construction, operation and maintenance of equipment, facilities and distribution systems.

occupations.name: Electronic Engineering Draftspersons, Technicians
occupations.description: Electronic Engineering Draftspersons and Technicians assist in electronic engineering research, design, manufacture, assembly, construction, operation and maintenance of equipment, facilities and distribution systems.

occupations.name: Mechanical Engineering Draftspersons, Technicians
occupations.description: Mechanical Engineering Draftspersons and Technicians assist in mechanical engineering research, design, manufacture, construction, operation and maintenance of machines, manufacturing equipment, mechanical installations and facilities.

occupations.name: Safety Inspectors
occupations.description: Safety Inspectors inspect machines, equipment, working conditions and public places to ensure compliance with government and industry standards and regulations, in relation to occupational health and safety.

occupations.name: Other Building and Engineering Technicians
occupations.description: Other Building and Engineering Technicians includes occupations such as Maintenance Planners, Metallurgical or Materials Technicians, and Mine Deputies.
titles: Building and Engineering Technicians (not covered elsewhere)

occupations.name: ICT Support Technicians
occupations.description: ICT Support Technicians provide support for the deployment and maintenance of computer infrastructure and web technology and the diagnosis and resolution of technical problems.

occupations.name: Telecommunications Technical Specialists
occupations.description: Telecommunications Technical Specialists develop, monitor and carry out technical support functions for telecommunications networks and install computer equipment, computer systems and microwave, telemetry, multiplexing, satellite and other radio and electromagnetic wave communication systems.

occupations.name: Automotive Electricians
occupations.description: Automotive Electricians install, maintain and repair electrical wiring and electronic components in motor vehicles.

occupations.name: Motor Mechanics
occupations.description: Motor Mechanics repair, maintain and test motor vehicle and other internal combustion engines and related mechanical components.

occupations.name: Structural Steel and Welding Trades Workers
occupations.description: Structural Steel and Welding Trades Workers cut, shape, join and repair metal components of iron and steel structures, boilers, pressure vessels and pipes, ships and other vessels.

occupations.name: Aircraft Maintenance Engineers
occupations.description: Aircraft Maintenance Engineers maintain and repair aircraft structures, and avionic and mechanical systems.

occupations.name: Metal Fitters and Machinists
occupations.description: Metal Fitters and Machinists fit and assemble fabricated metal parts into products, set up machining tools, production machines and textile machines, and operate machining tools and machines to shape metal stock and castings.

occupations.name: Precision Metal Trades Workers
occupations.description: Precision Metal Trades Workers fabricate, assemble, maintain and repair metal precision instruments.
titles: Watch and Clock Makers and Repairers

occupations.name: Panelbeaters
occupations.description: Panelbeaters repair damage to metal, fibreglass and plastic body work on vehicles, and form replacement vehicle panels.

occupations.name: Vehicle Body Builders and Trimmers
occupations.description: Vehicle Body Builders and Trimmers manufacture and repair prototype production units and purpose-built vehicle bodies, and install, repair and replace the interior trim of vehicles.

occupations.name: Vehicle Painters
occupations.description: Vehicle Painters prepare surfaces of vehicles, match and mix colours and apply paint.

occupations.name: Bricklayers and Stonemasons
occupations.description: Bricklayers and Stonemasons lay bricks, pre-cut stones and other types of building blocks in mortar to construct and repair walls, partitions, arches and other structures, and cut and shape hard and soft stone blocks and masonry slabs for the construction and renovation of stone structures and monumental masonry.

occupations.name: Carpenters and Joiners
occupations.description: Carpenters and Joiners construct, erect, install, renovate and repair structures and fixtures made of wood, plywood, wallboard and other materials, and cut, shape and fit timber parts to form structures and fittings.

occupations.name: Painting Trades Workers
occupations.description: Painting Trades Workers apply paint, varnish, wallpaper and other finishes to protect, maintain and decorate surfaces of buildings and structures.

occupations.name: Plasterers
occupations.description: Plasterers apply and fix plasterboard partitions, suspended ceilings, fire rating systems, acoustic tiles, and composite wall linings to buildings, and apply decorative and protective coverings of plaster, cement and similar materials to the interiors and exteriors of structures.

occupations.name: Plumbers
occupations.description: Plumbers install, maintain and repair pipes, drains, guttering and metal roofing, mechanical services and related equipment for water supply, gas, drainage, sewerage, heating, cooling and ventilation systems.

occupations.name: Electricians
occupations.description: Electricians design, assemble, install, test, commission, diagnose, maintain and repair electrical networks, systems, circuits, equipment, components, appliances and facilities for industrial, commercial and domestic purposes, and service and repair lifts, escalators and related equipment.

occupations.name: Airconditioning and Refrigeration Mechanics
occupations.description: Airconditioning and Refrigeration Mechanics assemble, install, maintain and repair industrial, commercial and domestic airconditioning and refrigeration systems and equipment.

occupations.name: Electrical Distribution Trades Workers
occupations.description: Electrical Distribution Trades Workers prepare, install, repair, maintain and patrol electric power distribution networks.

occupations.name: Electronics Trades Workers
occupations.description: Electronics Trades Workers maintain, adjust and repair electronic equipment such as business machines, video and audio equipment, and electronic instruments and control systems, and transmit and receive radio messages.

occupations.name: Telecommunications Trades Workers
occupations.description: Telecommunications Trades Workers install, maintain and repair data transmission equipment, aerial lines, conduits, cables, radio antennae and telecommunications equipment and appliances.

occupations.name: Bakers and Pastrycooks
occupations.description: Bakers and Pastrycooks prepare and bake bread loaves and rolls, buns, cakes, biscuits and pastry goods.

occupations.name: Butchers and Smallgoods Makers
occupations.description: Butchers and Smallgoods Makers select, cut, trim, prepare and arrange meat for sale and supply, operate meat and smallgoods processing machines, and manage the processes in the production of smallgoods.

occupations.name: Chefs
occupations.description: Chefs plan and organise the preparation and cooking of food in dining and catering establishments.

occupations.name: Cooks
occupations.description: Cooks prepare, season and cook food in dining and catering establishments.

occupations.name: Animal Attendants and Trainers
occupations.description: Animal Attendants and Trainers train, feed, groom and care for animals.

occupations.name: Veterinary Nurses
occupations.description: Veterinary Nurses care for animals under treatment and in temporary residence at veterinary facilities and assist Veterinarians to perform procedures and operations.

occupations.name: Greenkeepers
occupations.description: Greenkeepers establish and maintain fine turf, grassed areas and synthetic surfaces used for sporting events.

occupations.name: Hairdressers
occupations.description: Hairdressers cut, style, colour, straighten and permanently wave hair, and treat hair and scalp conditions.

occupations.name: Printers
occupations.description: Printers set up and operate letterpress, lithographic, flexographic, gravure, newspaper, instant, digital and offset printing presses.

occupations.name: Upholsterers
occupations.description: Upholsterers make, rebuild and repair upholstered articles such as chairs, sofas, beds and mattresses.

occupations.name: Cabinetmakers
occupations.description: Cabinetmakers fabricate and repair wooden furniture, and fit and assemble prepared wooden parts to make furniture.

occupations.name: Wood Machinists and Other Wood Trades Workers
occupations.description: Wood Machinists and Other Wood Trades Workers set up and operate woodworking machines and wood turning lathes to shape wood stock, finish and polish furniture, and make picture frames and frame paintings, photographs and other artwork.
titles: Other Wood Machinists and Wood Trades Workers

occupations.name: Boat Builders and Shipwrights
occupations.description: Boat Builders and Shipwrights construct, fit out and repair boats and ships.

occupations.name: Chemical, Gas, Petroleum and Power Plant Operators
occupations.description: Chemical, Gas, Petroleum and Power Generation Plant Operators control the operation of chemical production equipment, pump gas and oil from wellheads, refine and process petroleum products, and operate boilers, turbogenerators and associated plant to generate electrical power.

occupations.name: Gallery, Library and Museum Technicians
occupations.description: Gallery, Library and Museum Technicians prepare artworks, specimens and artefacts for collections, arrange and construct gallery exhibits, and assist Librarians to organise and operate systems for handling recorded material and files.

occupations.name: Performing Arts Technicians
occupations.description: Performing Arts Technicians provide technical and other assistance for the production, recording and broadcasting of artistic performances.

occupations.name: Other Miscellaneous Technicians and Trades Workers
occupations.description: Other Technicians and Trades Workers includes a wide variety of occupations such as Divers, Interior Decorators, Optical Dispensers, Optical Mechanics, Photographer's Assistants, Plastics Technicians, Wool Classers and Fire Protection Equipment Technicians.
titles: Technicians and Trades Workers (not covered elsewhere)

occupations.name: Ambulance Officers and Paramedics
occupations.description: Ambulance Officers and Paramedics provide emergency health care and transport for injured, sick, infirm and aged persons to medical facilities.

occupations.name: Dental Hygienists, Technicians and Therapists
occupations.description: Dental Hygienists, Technicians and Therapists provide supportive dental services in preventative and restorative dental procedures, and construct and repair dental appliances.

occupations.name: Diversional Therapists
occupations.description: Diversional Therapists plan, design, coordinate and implement recreation and leisure-based activity programs to support, challenge and enhance the psychological, spiritual, social, emotional and physical wellbeing of individuals.

occupations.name: Enrolled and Mothercraft Nurses
occupations.description: Enrolled and Mothercraft Nurses provide nursing care to patients in hospitals, aged care and other health care facilities and in the community, and assist parents in providing care to newborn infants under the supervision of a Registered Nurse or Midwife.

occupations.name: Indigenous Health Workers
occupations.description: Indigenous Health Workers assist with the coordination and provision of health care delivery to Indigenous communities.

occupations.name: Welfare Support Workers
occupations.description: Welfare Support Workers provide support, information and advice to clients on emotional, financial, recreational, health, housing and other social welfare matters, and evaluate and coordinate the services of welfare and community service agencies.

occupations.name: Child Carers
occupations.description: Child Carers provide care and supervision for children in residential homes and non-residential childcare centres.
titles: Out of School Hours Care Workers

occupations.name: Education Aides
occupations.description: Education Aides perform non-teaching duties to assist teaching staff in schools, provide care and supervision for children in preschools, and provide assistance to Aboriginal, Torres Strait Islander and Maori students and their teachers.
titles: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Education Workers

occupations.name: Aged and Disabled Carers
occupations.description: Aged and Disabled Carers provide general household assistance, emotional support, care and companionship for aged and disabled persons in their own homes.

occupations.name: Dental Assistants
occupations.description: Dental Assistants prepare patients for dental examination and assist Dental Practitioners, Hygienists and Therapists in providing care and treatment.

occupations.name: Nursing Support and Personal Care Workers
occupations.description: Nursing Support and Personal Care Workers provide assistance, support and direct care to patients in a variety of health, welfare and community settings.

occupations.name: Special Care Workers
occupations.description: Special Care Workers provide care and supervision for children and young people in residential and institutional facilities, and provide care and support to people in refuges.
titles: Child and Youth Residential Care Assistants

occupations.name: Bar Attendants and Baristas
occupations.description: Bar Attendants and Baristas prepare, mix and serve alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks to patrons in bars in licensed establishments, and prepare and serve espresso coffee and other hot beverages to patrons in cafes, coffee shops and dining establishments.

occupations.name: Cafe Workers
occupations.description: Cafe Workers sell and serve food and beverages for consumption on premises in cafes and similar establishments.

occupations.name: Gaming Workers
occupations.description: Gaming Workers provide gaming services within casinos and other gambling establishments.

occupations.name: Hotel Service Managers
occupations.description: Hotel Service Managers supervise and coordinate the activities of hotel service workers.

occupations.name: Waiters
occupations.description: Waiters serve food and beverages in hotels, restaurants, clubs and dining establishments.

occupations.name: Other Hospitality Workers
occupations.description: Other Hospitality Workers includes a number of jobs like Bar Usefuls or Bussers, and Doorpersons or Luggage Porters.

occupations.name: Fire and Emergency Workers
occupations.description: Fire and Emergency Workers attend emergencies to minimise risk to community safety and security and protect life and property.

occupations.name: Police
occupations.description: Police protect and preserve property, public order and safety through the enforcement of laws.

occupations.name: Prison Officers
occupations.description: Prison Officers supervise and control the activities of inmates in prisons and other correctional institutions.

occupations.name: Security Officers and Guards
occupations.description: Security Officers and Guards provide security and investigative services to organisations and individuals.

occupations.name: Beauty Therapists
occupations.description: Beauty Therapists provide skin analyses, facial therapies, skin-care treatments and body treatments such as massage to clients.

occupations.name: Driving Instructors
occupations.description: Driving Instructors instruct individuals and groups in the theory and application of driving motor vehicles.

occupations.name: Gallery, Museum and Tour Guides
occupations.description: Gallery, Museum and Tour Guides direct and guide visitors in galleries and museums, and escort visitors on sightseeing, educational and other tours.

occupations.name: Tourism and Travel Advisers
occupations.description: Tourism and Travel Advisers plan and organise travel and accommodation for clients, and provide travel and accommodation information to tourists.

occupations.name: Travel Attendants
occupations.description: Travel Attendants provide services for the safety and comfort of passengers in aircraft, ships and railway sleeping cars.

occupations.name: Fitness Instructors
occupations.description: Fitness Instructors direct, instruct and guide individuals and groups in the pursuit of physical fitness and wellbeing.

occupations.name: Outdoor Adventure Guides
occupations.description: Outdoor Adventure Guides direct, instruct and guide individuals and groups in outdoor adventure activities such as bungy jumping, fishing and hunting, mountaineering, trekking and whitewater rafting.

occupations.name: Sports Coaches, Instructors and Officials
occupations.description: Sports Coaches, Instructors and Officials coach, train and instruct participants in sports, and officiate at sporting events.

occupations.name: Contract, Program and Project Administrators
occupations.description: Contract, Program and Project Administrators plan and undertake administration of contracts, organisational programs, special projects and support services.

occupations.name: Office Managers
occupations.description: Office Managers organise and control the functions and resources of offices such as administrative systems and office personnel.

occupations.name: Practice Managers
occupations.description: Practice Managers organise and control the functions and resources of professional practices such as administrative systems and practice personnel.

occupations.name: Personal Assistants
occupations.description: Personal Assistants perform liaison, coordination and organisational tasks in support of Managers and Professionals.

occupations.name: Secretaries
occupations.description: Secretaries perform secretarial, clerical and other administrative tasks in support of Managers, Legal Professionals and other professionals.

occupations.name: General Clerks
occupations.description: General Clerks perform a range of clerical and administrative tasks.

occupations.name: Keyboard Operators
occupations.description: Keyboard Operators input and process text and data, and prepare, edit and generate documents for storage, processing, publication and transmission.

occupations.name: Call or Contact Centre Workers
occupations.description: Call or Contact Centre Workers respond to telephone, Internet and email inquiries and complaints about an organisation's goods and services, and promote the goods and services.
titles: Call Centre or Contact Centre Operators
Call Centre or Contact Centre Team Leaders

occupations.name: Information Officers
occupations.description: Information Officers respond to personal, written and telephone inquiries and complaints about the organisation's goods and services, provide information and refer people to other sources.

occupations.name: Receptionists
occupations.description: Receptionists receive and welcome visitors, patients, guests and clients, and respond to inquiries and requests.

occupations.name: Accounting Clerks
occupations.description: Accounting Clerks monitor creditor and debtor accounts, undertake related routine documentation, and calculate and investigate the cost of wages, materials, overheads and other operating costs.

occupations.name: Bookkeepers
occupations.description: Bookkeepers maintain and evaluate records of financial transactions in account books and computerised accounting systems.

occupations.name: Payroll Clerks
occupations.description: Payroll Clerks prepare payrolls and related records for employee salaries and statutory record-keeping purposes.

occupations.name: Bank Workers
occupations.description: Bank Workers receive deposits and pay out money in financial and commercial institutions, keep records of transactions, issue receipts and cash cheques.

occupations.name: Credit and Loans Officers
occupations.description: Credit and Loans Officers analyse, evaluate and process credit and loan applications.

occupations.name: Insurance, Money Market and Statistical Clerks
occupations.description: Insurance, Money Market and Statistical Clerks prepare and check documentation associated with insurance, maintain records of securities transactions and registrations, offer odds and accept bets, and compile data and undertake statistical and actuarial computations.

occupations.name: Couriers and Postal Deliverers
occupations.description: Couriers and Postal Deliverers deliver small items such as documents, messages, mail and parcels.

occupations.name: Filing and Registry Clerks
occupations.description: Filing and Registry Clerks process and handle information and documents to maintain access to and security of database and record management systems.

occupations.name: Other Clerical and Office Support Workers
occupations.description: Other Clerical and Office Support Workers includes occupations such as Classified Advertising Clerks, Meter Readers and Parking Inspectors.
titles: Clerical and Office Support Workers (not covered elsewhere)

occupations.name: Purchasing and Supply Logistics Clerks
occupations.description: Purchasing and Supply Logistics Clerks prepare and process orders for goods and services, monitor stock levels and supply sources and maintain stock and inventory levels, record and coordinate the flow of materials between departments, prepare production schedules, and administer and coordinate storage and distribution operations within organisations.

occupations.name: Transport and Despatch Clerks
occupations.description: Transport and Despatch Clerks verify and maintain records of incoming and outgoing goods, prepare goods for despatch, arrange clearance and collection of imported cargo from customs and bond stores, and arrange shipment of cargo for export.

occupations.name: Conveyancers and Legal Executives
occupations.description: Conveyancers and Legal Executives act for and on behalf of clients in the areas of property transfer, company and business law, trusts, wills, probate and litigation.

occupations.name: Court and Legal Clerks
occupations.description: Court and Legal Clerks provide administrative and operational support to Legal Professionals by performing clerical work associated with the functions of courts, legal practices and the administration of trusts and estates.

occupations.name: Debt Collectors
occupations.description: Debt Collectors collect consumer, commercial, insurance and other forms of debt for clients, make arrangements to settle overdue accounts, formalise payment arrangements and follow up until accounts are fully paid.

occupations.name: Human Resource Clerks
occupations.description: Human Resources Clerks maintain and update personnel records such as information on transfers and promotions, employee leave taken and accumulated, salaries, superannuation and taxation, qualifications and training.

occupations.name: Inspectors and Regulatory Officers
occupations.description: Inspectors and Regulatory Officers administer and enforce government and corporate regulations and standards.

occupations.name: Insurance Investigators, Loss Adjusters and Risk Surveyors
occupations.description: Insurance Investigators, Loss Adjusters and Risk Surveyors conduct investigations into insurance claims to ensure their validity, inspect and assess the damage and loss to insured properties and businesses, estimate insurance costs, and inspect insured properties to evaluate conditions affecting underwriting standards.

occupations.name: Library Assistants
occupations.description: Library Assistants issue, receive and shelve library items and maintain associated records.

occupations.name: Other Miscellaneous Clerical and Administrative Workers
occupations.description: Other Clerical and Administrative Workers includes occupations such as Production Assistants (Film, Television, Radio or Stage), Proof Readers, Radio Despatchers, Clinical Coders and Facilities Administrators.
titles: Clerical and Administrative Workers (not covered elsewhere)
Production Assistants (Film, Television, Radio or Stage)

occupations.name: Insurance Agents
occupations.description: Insurance Agents represent insurance companies in selling insurance to clients.

occupations.name: Sales Representatives
occupations.description: Sales Representatives represent companies to sell their goods and business services to wholesale and retail establishments.
titles: Sales Representatives (Motor Vehicle Parts and Accessories)

occupations.name: Real Estate Sales Agents
occupations.description: Real Estate Sales Agents sell, lease and manage commercial and private properties, and broker the buying and selling of businesses.

occupations.name: Sales Assistants (General)
occupations.description: Sales Assistants (General) sell goods and services, such as food, clothing, hardware, household appliances, office supplies and cosmetics, in retail and wholesale establishments.

occupations.name: ICT Sales Assistants
occupations.description: ICT Sales Assistants sell computing and telecommunications related goods and services in retail and wholesale establishments.

occupations.name: Motor Vehicle and Vehicle Parts Salespersons
occupations.description: Motor Vehicle and Vehicle Parts Salespersons sell motor vehicles, boats, caravans, earthmoving equipment, vehicle accessories and parts in retail and wholesale establishments.

occupations.name: Pharmacy Sales Assistants
occupations.description: Pharmacy Sales Assistants sell pharmaceutical goods, toiletries and related goods in retail pharmacies (Pharmacy Technicians are not included here, they are included in Medical Technicians).

occupations.name: Retail Supervisors
occupations.description: Retail Supervisors supervise and coordinate the activities of retail sales workers.

occupations.name: Service Station Attendants
occupations.description: Service Station Attendants sell fuel, lubricants and other automotive accessories, and perform minor maintenance on motor vehicles at service stations.

occupations.name: Other Sales Assistants and Salespersons
occupations.description: Other Sales Assistants and Salespersons includes occupations such as Materials Recyclers and Rental Salespersons.
titles: Sales Assistants and Salespersons (not covered elsewhere)

occupations.name: Checkout Operators and Office Cashiers
occupations.description: Checkout Operators and Office Cashiers operate cash registers and receive payments from customers, and issue receipts and return change due.

occupations.name: Retail and Wool Buyers
occupations.description: Retail and Wool Buyers select and buy goods for resale in retail establishments, and value and buy wool sold by wool growers.

occupations.name: Ticket Salespersons
occupations.description: Ticket Salespersons sell tickets and make reservations for services such as travel and admission to sporting and entertainment venues, and collect fares on transport vehicles.

occupations.name: Visual Merchandisers
occupations.description: Visual Merchandisers plan and install internal, window and fixed displays to show goods to their best advantage.

occupations.name: Other Sales Support Workers
occupations.description: This group includes Sales Support Workers not covered elsewhere.

occupations.name: Clay, Concrete, Glass and Stone Processing Machine Operators
occupations.description: Clay, Concrete, Glass and Stone Processing Machine Operators operate machines to manufacture and finish a variety of clay, concrete, glassware and stone products by extruding, shaping, mixing, grinding, cutting and other processes.
titles: Other Clay, Concrete, Glass and Stone Processing Machine Operators

occupations.name: Paper and Wood Processing Machine Operators
occupations.description: Paper and Wood Processing Machine Operators operate machines to manufacture paper packaging and other paper products, fibreboard stock, logs, plywood, particle board, solid laminate and similar timber products.

occupations.name: Photographic Developers and Printers
occupations.description: Photographic Developers and Printers edit and adjust digital images, develop photographic film, and print photographic images from digital media, negatives and positives using computer software, fully automatic equipment and by separate processes.

occupations.name: Plastics and Rubber Production Machine Operators
occupations.description: Plastics and Rubber Production Machine Operators operate machines to manufacture and finish plastic and rubber products.
titles: Other Plastics and Rubber Production Machine Operators
Plastic Compounding and Reclamation Machine Operators
Reinforced Plastic and Composite Production Workers

occupations.name: Sewing Machinists
occupations.description: Sewing Machinists operate industrial sewing machines to sew and finish garments and soft furnishings such as curtains.

occupations.name: Textile and Footwear Production Machine Operators
occupations.description: Textile and Footwear Production Machine Operators operate machines to process raw hides and skins, raw textile fibres, and dye, weave and knit fibres for use in textile and footwear production.
titles: Hide and Skin Processing Machine Operators
Other Textile and Footwear Production Machine Operators
Textile Dyeing and Finishing Machine Operators
Yarn Carding and Spinning Machine Operators

occupations.name: Other Machine Operators
occupations.description: Other Machine Operators includes a range of occupations such as Chemical Production Machine Operators, Motion Picture Projectionists, Sand Blasters and Sterilisation Technicians.

occupations.name: Crane, Hoist and Lift Operators
occupations.description: Crane, Hoist and Lift Operators operate stationary and mobile cranes, hoists, lifts and winches to lift, move and place materials, equipment and people in areas such as building sites, factories, mines, sawmills, wharves and shipyards.

occupations.name: Drillers, Miners and Shot Firers
occupations.description: Drillers, Miners and Shot Firers assemble, position and operate drilling rigs and mining plant, and detonate explosives to extract materials from the earth and demolish structures.

occupations.name: Engineering Production Workers
occupations.description: Engineering Production Workers perform a range of production process tasks to refine and treat metals and mineral ore, fire ceramics, and operate plant to produce and finish metal products such as rods, tubing and structural shapes, and moulds for casting.

occupations.name: Other Stationary Plant Operators
occupations.description: Other Stationary Plant Operators includes a range of occupations such as Boiler or Engine Operators, Bulk Materials Handling Plant Operators, Cement Production Plant Operators, Concrete Batching Plant Operators, Concrete Pump Operators, Paper and Pulp Mill Operators, Railway Signal Operators, Train Controllers, Waste Water or Water Plant Operators and Weighbridge Operators.
titles: Waste Water and Water Plant Operators

occupations.name: Agricultural, Forestry and Horticultural Plant Operators
occupations.description: Agricultural, Forestry and Horticultural Plant Operators operate agricultural, forestry and horticultural plant to clear and cultivate land, sow and harvest crops, and fell trees and move logs.
titles: Agricultural and Horticultural Mobile Plant Operators

occupations.name: Earthmoving Plant Operators
occupations.description: Earthmoving Plant Operators operate plant to excavate earth, ore and rock, break up pavement, road, rock and obstructions, move and load earth, rock and debris, and level, smooth and compact surfaces in construction and other projects.

occupations.name: Forklift Drivers
occupations.description: Forklift Drivers operate forklifts to move bulk materials, containers, crates, palletised goods, cartons and bales.

occupations.name: Other Mobile Plant Operators
occupations.description: Other Mobile Plant Operators includes a number of occupation such as Aircraft Baggage Handlers and Airline Ground Crew, Linemarkers, Paving Plant Operators, Railway Track Plant Operators, Road Roller Operators and Streetsweeper Operators.
titles: Aircraft Baggage Handlers and Airline Ground Crews

occupations.name: Bus and Coach Drivers
occupations.description: Bus and Coach Drivers drive buses and coaches to transport passengers over established and special routes.

occupations.name: Train and Tram Drivers
occupations.description: Train and Tram Drivers drive trains and trams to transport passengers and freight on rail networks.

occupations.name: Delivery Drivers
occupations.description: Delivery Drivers drive vans and cars to deliver goods.

occupations.name: Truck Drivers
occupations.description: Truck Drivers drive heavy trucks, removal vans, tankers and tow trucks to transport bulky goods and liquids.

occupations.name: Storepersons
occupations.description: Storepersons receive, handle and despatch goods in stores and warehouses.

occupations.name: Car Detailers
occupations.description: Car Detailers wash and clean exteriors and interiors of motor vehicles, and touch up paint work, glass and upholstery to prepare them for sale or rent.

occupations.name: Commercial Cleaners
occupations.description: Commercial Cleaners clean offices, residential complexes, hospitals, schools, industrial work areas, industrial machines, construction sites and other commercial premises using heavy duty cleaning equipment.

occupations.name: Domestic Cleaners
occupations.description: Domestic Cleaners clean and tidy private dwellings such as houses, units, flats, apartments and townhouses.

occupations.name: Housekeepers
occupations.description: Housekeepers perform cleaning and housekeeping duties in hotels, motels and other commercial premises, and in private residences.

occupations.name: Laundry Workers
occupations.description: Laundry Workers sort, clean, fold, iron and package linen, clothing and other items in laundries and drycleaning establishments, and private residences.

occupations.name: Other Cleaners
occupations.description: Other Cleaners clean surfaces, materials and objects, such as carpets, windows, walls, swimming pools and cooling towers, using specialised cleaning equipment and chemicals. Carpet Cleaners and Window Cleaners are included here.

occupations.name: Building and Plumbing Labourers
occupations.description: Building and Plumbing Labourers perform a variety of routine tasks associated with erecting and repairing structures and facilities, maintaining stormwater, drainage and sewerage systems, excavating earth and clearing and levelling sites, and installing and maintaining piping systems, fixtures and water regulators.

occupations.name: Concreters
occupations.description: Concreters pour, spread, smooth and finish concrete for structures such as floors, stairs, ramps, footpaths and bridges.

occupations.name: Fencers
occupations.description: Fencers erect and repair fences and gates.

occupations.name: Insulation and Home Improvement Installers
occupations.description: Insulation and Home Improvement Installers install a variety of insulation materials to improve resistance to heat, cold, air, sound and moisture, and install functional and decorative home improvements.

occupations.name: Paving and Surfacing Labourers
occupations.description: Paving and Surfacing Labourers perform routine tasks associated in laying bituminous and other paving materials on roads, runways, parking areas and other surfaces to be paved.

occupations.name: Structural Steel Construction Workers
occupations.description: Structural Steel Construction Workers assemble rigging gear to move and position equipment and structural components, erect scaffolding, position and secure steel reinforcing in concrete forms, and erect and dismantle structural steel frames.

occupations.name: Food and Drink Factory Workers
occupations.description: Food and Drink Factory Workers perform routine tasks in manufacturing food and beverages.
titles: Other Food and Drink Factory Workers

occupations.name: Meat Boners and Slicers, and Slaughterers
occupations.description: Meat Boners and Slicers, and Slaughterers trim and cut meat from bones, sides and carcasses, and slaughter livestock in abattoirs.

occupations.name: Meat, Poultry and Seafood Process Workers
occupations.description: Meat, Poultry and Seafood Process Workers slaughter and eviscerate poultry, and process, grade and package meat, poultry, fish and shellfish.

occupations.name: Packers
occupations.description: Packers weigh, wrap, seal and label chocolate, fruit, vegetables, meat, seafood and other products.

occupations.name: Product Assemblers
occupations.description: Product Assemblers put together components and subassemblies that go into the production of metal products, electrical and electronic equipment, jewellery and precious metal articles, and joinery products.

occupations.name: Metal Engineering Process Workers
occupations.description: Metal Engineering Process Workers perform routine tasks in manufacturing metal products.

occupations.name: Plastics and Rubber Factory Workers
occupations.description: Plastics and Rubber Factory Workers perform routine tasks in manufacturing plastic and rubber products.

occupations.name: Product Quality Controllers
occupations.description: Product Quality Controllers examine manufactured products and primary produce to ensure conformity to specifications and standards of presentation and quality.

occupations.name: Other Factory Process Workers
occupations.description: Other Factory Process Workers includes a number of occupations such as Cement and Concrete Plant Workers, Chemical Plant Workers, Clay Processing Factory Workers, Fabric and Textile Factory Workers, Footwear Factory Workers, Glass Processing Workers, Hide and Skin Processing Workers and Recycling Workers.

occupations.name: Fast Food Cooks
occupations.description: Fast Food Cooks prepare a restricted range of foods in fast food establishments.

occupations.name: Food Trades Assistants
occupations.description: Food Trades Assistants assist Food Trades Workers by performing routine food preparation, cleaning and storage tasks.

occupations.name: Kitchenhands
occupations.description: Kitchenhands assist kitchen and service staff in preparing and serving food, and clean food preparation and service areas.

occupations.name: Freight and Furniture Handlers
occupations.description: Freight and Furniture Handlers load and unload trucks, containers and rail cars, and transfer cargo between ships and other forms of transport and storage facilities.

occupations.name: Shelf Fillers
occupations.description: Shelf Fillers fill up shelves and display areas in stores and supermarkets.

occupations.name: Caretakers
occupations.description: Caretakers maintain and clean residential buildings, schools, offices, holiday camps, caravan parks and associated grounds.

occupations.name: Deck and Fishing Hands
occupations.description: Deck and Fishing Hands maintain ships' equipment and structures, and catch fish, crustacea and molluscs.

occupations.name: Handypersons
occupations.description: Handypersons clean, paint, repair and maintain buildings, grounds and facilities.

occupations.name: Printing Assistants and Table Workers
occupations.description: Printing Assistants and Table Workers perform routine printing tasks, operate bindery machines and perform manual binding and finishing of books and printed products.

occupations.name: Recycling and Rubbish Collectors
occupations.description: Recycling and Rubbish Collectors collect household, commercial and industrial waste for recycling and disposal.

occupations.name: Vending Machine Attendants
occupations.description: Vending Machine Attendants stock and maintain vending and amusement machines and collect money from coin boxes.

occupations.name: Other Miscellaneous Labourers
occupations.description: Other Labourers includes a wide variety of occupations such as Bicycle Mechanics, Car Park Attendants, Crossing Supervisors, Electrical or Telecommunications Trades Assistants, Leaflet or Newspaper Deliverers, Mechanic's Assistants, Railways Assistants, Sign Erectors, Ticket Collectors or Ushers, Trolley Collectors and Road Traffic Controllers.
